item.title: About
item.description: I am a Research Data Technician in the Department of Neurodegenerative Science at Van Andel Institute. I graduated magna cum laude from Kalamazoo College with a B.A. in Biology and Mathematics. My work focuses on computational analysis and modeling of neurodegenerative disease pathology and progression.
